group_name: INTERFERON RESPONSIVE CYTOTOXIC CD8 T CELL
source_rationale: Two specialized subtypes of CD8 T cells are annotated from this dataset: one defined by exceptionally high expression of early response genes ( FOSB, NR4A2, and CCL5 ), and the other termed "interferon responsive cytotoxic CD8 T cells," defined by granzyme and perforin expression ( GZMB, GZMA, GNLY, PRF1, GZMH ), anti-viral genes ( ISG20, IFIT3, APOBEC3C, GBP5 ) and genes associated with effector CD8 T cell function ( LAG3, IL2RB, IKZF3, TBX21 ).
